goal: To provide a personalized tutoring experience by adjusting the difficulty of questions based on detected student frustration levels, enhancing the learning process in real-time.
core_capabilities: Adjust question difficulty based on detected frustration levels.
Provide a seamless tutoring experience with a variety of question types and subjects.
Offer teachers insights into individual and class performance.
main_components: Frustration Detection Module: Analyzes student interactions and possibly camera feeds/audio to detect frustration levels.
Question Difficulty Adjustment Module: Modifies the difficulty level of questions based on inputs from the frustration detection module.
Learning Content Database: A repository of questions and learning materials categorized by subject and difficulty.
User Interface: Provides an interactive experience for students to receive questions and submit answers.
Analytics and Reporting Dashboard: Offers teachers insight into student performance and class trends.
Integration Layer: Facilitates communication between modules and the storage of student data.
assumptions: Student frustration can be detected accurately through available data sensors or interaction analytics.
There are reliable metrics to adjust question difficulty appropriately.
Teachers will have access to an interface to review student progress and system recommendations.
Students have access to devices that support the user interface for interaction with the AI tutor.
open_questions: How will the system initially calibrate each student's frustration levels accurately?
What privacy measures will be in place considering the potential use of cameras or microphones?
How quickly should the system react to changes in detected frustration levels to adjust difficulty without disrupting the learning process?
What fallback mechanisms will be implemented if frustration detection fails or data is insufficient?
Is there scope for integrating this system with existing learning management systems?
